note: Uniswap v3 pools pairing each Stock Token with USDG, enumerated from the factory. Prices are the raw token price, the same thing Chainlink publishes (P_equity x multiplier), so the two are directly comparable and no multiplier is unwound from either.
method: The venue was found by behaviour - Transfer counterparties that answer token0/token1/slot0 - and then confirmed by the factory claiming each pool through getPool. Prices come from slot0().sqrtPriceX96, adjusted for the 18-vs-6 decimal difference against USDG.

unidentifiedVenue.note: answers pool selectors on its own pools but not getPool; a second venue, left unnamed rather than guessed at
